candidates.title: Minimal local-complete decoration for Katz/AKN rhombohedral vertex atlas
candidates.summary: Frame the finite optimization problem m*(C1) for decorations whose locally legal vertex coronae equal the admissible AKN atlas.
promotion_requirements: source cell/face data committed with provenance
SAT/ILP or equivalent finite search encoding
regression tests for counts and exclusions

candidates.title: Periodic tiling whose vertex stars all lie in the AKN atlas
candidates.summary: 3/2 cubic approximant (tau' -> -2/3) with 576 vertices, 356 prolate and 220 oblate cells per period; every vertex star is one of the AKN atlas classes. Certified exactly by research/akn/certify.py.

candidates.title: Universe of face-to-face golden-rhombohedral vertex configurations
candidates.summary: Exactly 5450 classes up to I_h (exhaustive exact-cover enumeration over the 160 rhombohedral corners); all 24 AKN atlas classes are among them, leaving 5426 outside the atlas. Matches the 1993 J. Non-Cryst. Solids count.

candidates.title: Global perfection of Katz/AKN matching-rule decorations
candidates.summary: Separate global matching-rule problem: every locally legal tiling must belong to the intended AKN class. Not implied by C1.
